description: The app's sales (Dinero › Ventas in the dashboard): action "list" { status?, productId?, from?, to?, seller?, skip?, limit? } — newest first, each with product, units, paid (minor units) and currency when known, status (completed | refunded | charged_back | ended), refund and dispute, the buyer's userId, email and buyerName, canRefund, and the seller who was paid (seller, sellerName: one of the app's sellers, neblla_business "sellers"; none: the app). "documents" { saleId } — the links Stripe keeps for the buyer: a payment's receipt (receiptUrl) or a subscription's invoices (url, pdf); nothing is stored. "refund" { saleId } — gives the WHOLE payment back in Stripe (Neblla's 1 % with it; a seller's sale is given back by the seller, with the developer's commission when it can be recovered) and takes the purchase back at once (the player loses it, credits and paid bookings go back, the app hears a "revoked" purchase and the refund webhook fires). A subscription is not refunded here (not_refundable, reason "subscription"): the developer refunds or cancels it in their Stripe dashboard, at the sale's stripeUrl. Money leaves the developer's account: confirm with them first. The CSV downloads are in the dashboard (POST /api/backend/apps/:appId/sales/csv and /users/csv).
name: neblla_sales
